description: Solution 1: Add a Code node before 'Create a New' to extract and validate contact data
instructions: 1. Add the 'Extract Contact Data' code node BEFORE 'Create a New'
2. Connect it to receive output from wherever the AI provides contact data
3. Replace 'Create a New' with 'Create Contact - Fixed' that uses autoMapInputData instead of $fromAI()
4. The code node handles all data extraction and validation
